Name: NITV - SH's Timid Spirits
Author: plurffle
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://imgur.com/IVzj1jc.png[/img]﻿﻿

Here is a little companion mod to my other latest Nature In The Valley mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42968]SH's Wild Animals In The Valley[/url]"  ₊˚⊹♡[/center]
[left]
﻿
This mod adds little critters that a bit of a more [i]mystical[/i] taste to your environment. Find fairies, little mushroom pals, soft sprites, gentle wisps, and friendly junimos roaming across the valley! Catching them means you'll receive appropriate vanilla resources such as mushrooms, seeds, clay, moss, etc (plus a custom candy treat if you find a certain critter at the mines!)... Or don't catch them and let them be, that's a good thing to do too.

Oh, and don't rush over of course because most of them are quite shy!

As of now, I've decided that the critters themselves [b]cannot[/b] be donated/sold/placed in terrariums. Catching them means you'll get [u]items[/u] from them instead (feel free to suggest better drop ideas). And these little fellas are quite rare, especially if you're using other NITV mods (and a lot of them have set times and seasons to spawn in). These are subject to change if requested.[/left]
